metadata.title: Who supplies the capital and sets the rules
metadata.disclaimer: Listing is not endorsement and is not financial, insurance or investment advice.
metadata.scope: Targeted primary-source evidence map; not an exhaustive legal or market census. South Asia includes Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka; Southeast Asia includes all eleven countries.
metadata.method: Primary issuer, programme, government, regulator, UN and MDB sources searched; announcements distinguished from contracts and settlements. No independently evaluated subsidy effect admitted. Unknown legal permission is not prohibition.
schema_notes: All six requested top-level arrays retained; empty arrays mean no new admissible records for that category in R7.
Additional fields preserve regulatory scope, premium support and source-check detail.
Actor type is a directory category, not a licensing determination. Insurtechs are mapped to modeller; HERA to humanitarian; MILMA to partnership.
Alliance side describes the role in this map. NDF and SCBF are facilities/platforms even where their funds support supply.
All loop/lever pathways are analyst mappings, not measured impacts.
Unknown monetary fields are not zero; excluded claims are outside verified finding tables.
country_risk_finance instrument layer is contingent for the support architecture; underlying country package may combine all five layers.

instruments.name: Parametric heat cover
instruments.plain_definition: Pays under a contract when a specified heat index crosses a threshold.
instruments.how_it_breaks_the_cycle: Inferred pathway: pre-agreed funding can preserve household income and reduce emergency budget pressure; effectiveness depends on delivery.
instruments.risk_holder: Insured party retains uncovered losses; carrier holds contractual insured layer.
instruments.speed: No general time-to-money estimate established; separate trigger, insurer settlement and beneficiary receipt.
instruments.typical_cost: No defensible general price. Only case-specific amounts in money_ledger.
instruments.limits: Index mismatch, benefits caps and payment timing remain material.
instruments.basis_risk: Weather index can fail to reflect actual harm; grant support also has targeting and coverage gaps.
instruments.reaches_poorest_why: Distribution through trusted groups and subsidy can help; documentation, account access and renewal costs can exclude.

examples.text: Parametric heat cover example; details in actor and support records.

instruments.uncertainty: Not a generic permission, quote, renewal promise or verified impact estimate.

schemes.name: SEWA heat cover, April 2024–March 2025
schemes.insured_or_covered: Worker income protection during extreme heat; cohort has ended, not a finding that the programme ended.
schemes.heat_basis: Worker income protection during extreme heat; cohort has ended, not a finding that the programme ended.

trigger.metric: Consecutive extreme daily air-temperature observations; not humidity-adjusted merely because product is called Heat Index Cover.
trigger.threshold: CGAP reports district thresholds spanning 41.6–46.1°C after two consecutive days; full district schedule not verified.
trigger.data_source: Full contractual data feed not verified for this cohort.
trigger.window: Two consecutive days; April 2024–March 2025 policy year

premium.paid_by: SEWA / HERA programme and member arrangements; exact 2024 premium split not verified. Do not substitute 2025 premium.

payouts.date: Claims triggered by June within April 2024–March 2025 cohort; precise settlement dates not verified
payouts.fx: 83.6566 INR = 1 USD; 2024 Federal Reserve annual average
payouts.recipients: Around 46000 women, insurer-reported; individual reconciled receipts not verified
payouts.channel: Programme case describes bank-account delivery; specific batch dates not verified
payouts.use: Income replacement intended; independently measured use not verified

schemes.basis_risk: Inferred: area-level weather can differ from individual heat exposure or livelihood loss.
schemes.fallback: Separate donor-funded lower-temperature cash layer reported; thresholds conflict across accounts (see trigger_notes).

inclusion.older_people: Age limits and accessibility not verified
inclusion.disabled_people: Eligibility and accessible payment arrangements not verified
inclusion.migrants: Portability and documentation rules not verified

schemes.consumer_protection: Contract wording, privacy, dispute and declined-payment records not verified; lack of published evidence is not evidence of mis-selling.

evidence.text: Operational report; not an independent causal evaluation.
CGAP documents the two-day trigger and separate cash layer; interview case, not an independent impact evaluation.
